notes.title: Yappie! Knockout Map Update
notes.content:
We are having a big update on the gaming maps. There will be 12 new maps with some new gameplay for you to enjoy. We hope this announcement with latest information will let you get a leg up on the competition!

The details for this update are as follows:
1. Blocks Party
Game mode: Survival
Game time: 2:00
Gameplay: Avoid the walls and stay on the platform.
Winner of the level: All the players who survive the game can move on to the next level.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/tvVBH5zjJselFEX.png
2. Hit Parade
Game mode: Race
Game time: 3:00
Gameplay: Navigate the obstacles and race to the finish line.
Winner of the level: If it's the first round then 80% of current players can advance. If it's the second round then 60% of current players can advance. 
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/AT95bFj6vhpauQ3.png
3. Windmills
Game mode: Race
Game time: 3:30
Gameplay: Navigate the obstacles and race to the finish line.
Winner of the level: If it's the first round then 80% of current players can advance. If it's the second round then 60% of current players can advance. 
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/UTdr1SL6pPAkGcF.png
4. Bombardment
Game mode: Race
Game time: 3:00
Gameplay: Navigate the obstacles and race to the finish line.
Winner of the level: If it's the first round then 80% of current players can advance. If it's the second round then 60% of current players can advance. 
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/bFySE4g5ckjKalI.png
5. Suspension
Game mode: Survival
Game time: 2:30
Gameplay: Avoid falling off the hoverboard and reach the finish.
Winner of the level: All the players who survive the game can move on to the next level.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/wbNtqHAIB9JF6Mx.png
6. Slime Climb
Game mode: Race
Game time: None
Gameplay: Outrun the slime and reach the finish line.
Winner of the level: If it's the third round then 50% of current players can advance. If it's the forth round then ONLY ONE players can win.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/NB3gRVEqOUd1Sef.png
7. SeeSaw
Game mode: Race
Game time: 3:00
Gameplay: Run and balance across rows of see-saws to reach the finish line.
Winner of the level: 80% of current players can advance.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/56ufriC7F9J3m4K.png
8. Full Tilt
Game mode: Race
Game time: 3:00
Gameplay: Run and balance across rows of 360 see-saws to reach the finish line.
Winner of the level: 60% of current players can advance.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/JXGckxLj9ipWHZr.png
9. Fan Frolics
Game mode: Race
Game time: 2:00
Gameplay: Navigate the obstacles and race to the finish line.
Winner of the level: 60% of current players can advance.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/ASkza6LpD2bXJsi.png
10. Conveyor Clash 
Game mode: Race

Winner of the level: 60% of current players can advance.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/wju8KY9QPmaSlqC.png
11. Wham Bam Boom
Game mode: Race
Game time: 2:00
Gameplay: Navigate the obstacles and race to the finish line.
Winner of the level: 80% of current players can advance.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/qZfDkTU3iwyp9NC.png
12. Pixel Hearts
Game mode: Race
Game time: 2:00
Gameplay: Navigate the obstacles and race to the finish line.
Winner of the level: 80% of current players can advance.
https://s2.loli.net/2023/07/17/F5wEJDKXrHR6QjN.png

Enjoy and have fun！ 

Yahaha Studios

notes.title: Hotfix available
notes.content:
The emergency fix for Yappie! Knockout has been released! 

- It addresses the crashing issue that some players experienced when entering the second level of the game.

We want to sincerely apologize for any issues you may have experienced with our game on Steam recently.


Yahaha Studios
